meaning: Titles and reading notes drafted by an AI agent in the register of the paper they annotate. No mathematician has reviewed them.

notes.Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.ringModes: The theorem changes the representative on a null set before asserting a pointwise finite expansion on every ring.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.rowSolenoi: Lean defines fderiv as zero where the Fréchet derivative does not exist; this pointwise trace statement uses that totalized derivative.
notes.Breakdown.FracInternal.ProfilePowerJumps: This identity uses Lean’s total real-power and derivative functions, so the statement does not require positive L or s.
